- **Close discrepancy:** The verified snapshot shows a 2026-11-01 close of **2263.06**, while the `get_stock_data` CSV shows **2263.04**. Open (2252.59), high (2273.08), low (2252.40) and volume (4,550,802,944) match. I use the snapshot value (2263.06) throughout. - **Other indicators:** The 10 EMA, 50 SMA, 200 SMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger middle and ATR values from `get_indicators` match the snapshot.

## 2. Indicator selection (8, complementary)

| Role | Indicator | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Long-term trend | `close_200_sma` | Strategic bull/bear boundary |
| Medium-term trend | `close_50_sma` | Dynamic resistance/support and trend slope |
| Short-term trend | `close_10_ema` | Fast read on momentum shifts |

| Volume confirmation | `vwma` | Whether volume supports the price move |

## 3. Price structure (from the OHLCV data)

- **Base and breakout:** ETH-USD traded in a narrow ~1,840–1,920 closing range from late July to 2026-08-18 (close 1916.46). On **2026-08-19** it gapped higher on heavy volume (29.6B) and closed at **2251.46**. It extended to a close of 2515.28 on 08-21.
- **Uptrend peak:** After consolidating around 2,400–2,520 in late August and early September, it pushed higher. The peak close was **2776.47** on **2026-09-21** (intraday high 2805.50). It then held roughly 2,670–2,730 into **2026-10-06** (close 2697.52).
- **Breakdown:** On **10-07** and **10-08** the close fell from 2697.52 to 2573.53 and then 2471.91, on ~20B volume each day. That was the first clear violation of the late-September/early-October range.
- **Lower highs since the breakdown:** Closes peaked at 2534.70 (10-11), then 2496.63 (10-13), 2470.77 (10-21) and 2357.62 (10-28). Each rebound was lower than the last.
- **Second leg down:** On **10-29** the close fell from 2357.62 to **2249.50** on 18.8B volume. On 10-30 the low reached **2173.30** (volume 20.0B), with a close of 2241.05.
- **Stabilization:** The closes on 10-31 (2252.75) and 11-01 (2263.06) are small bounces on low volume (4.36B and 4.55B). The 11-01 range (2252.40–2273.08) is only ~20.7 points wide, well below the ATR of 79.64. This is compression after two high-volume down days, not yet a confirmed reversal.
- **Net drawdown:** The close of 2263.06 is about 18.5% below the 09-21 peak close (2776.47) and about 16.1% below the 10-06 close (2697.52).

## 4. Trend indicators

- **200 SMA, 2157.63 (rising slowly):**
  - It was 2113.97 on 10-02, so it has climbed steadily.
  - Price is **105.43 above it** (about 4.9% of the SMA).
  - The 10-30 intraday low (2173.30) stayed about 15 points above the 200 SMA that day (2158.47).
  - The long-term trend benchmark has not been broken.
- **50 SMA, 2515.28 (rolling over):**
  - It peaked near 2556.17 on 10-11 and has declined every day since.
  - Price is **252.22 below it**, so the medium-term trend has turned negative.
  - The 50 SMA is still far above the 200 SMA (~357 points). No death cross is close.
- **10 EMA, 2307.89 (falling hard):**
  - It was 2692.12 on 10-06, and it has declined in all but a few sessions since.
  - Price is **44.83 below it**.
  - The first sign of short-term improvement would be a close back above this level.
- **Stack:** Price (2263) < 10 EMA (2308) < 50 SMA (2515), with price > 200 SMA (2158). That is a corrective, medium-term bearish structure inside a still-intact long-term uptrend. The 200 SMA is the key regime line.

## 5. Momentum

- **MACD:**
  - The MACD line crossed below zero between 10-10 (+3.23) and 10-11 (-2.07).
  - It is now **-71.09**, with the signal line at **-61.63** and the histogram at **-9.46**. That is a bearish configuration: line below signal, both negative.
  - The line's rate of decline has slowed: -68.57 (10-30), -70.90 (10-31), -71.09 (11-01). That suggests downside momentum is decelerating, but there is no bullish crossover yet.
  - A turn in the histogram toward zero would be the first early signal.
- **RSI, 33.67:**
  - It fell from 63.95 (10-04) to a low of **30.29** on 10-30. It has not closed below 30.
  - It is near oversold but not in oversold territory.
  - There is no bullish divergence in the data. Price and RSI both made lower lows on 10-29/10-30 compared with the prior 17-Oct low of 37.19.
  - In a falling-average regime, RSI can stay in the 30s. Treat it as a stretch warning, not a buy signal.

## 6. Volatility and volume

- **Bollinger Bands:** Middle **2369.55**, upper **2519.93**, lower **2219.18**.
  - Price sits 43.88 above the lower band and 106.49 below the middle.
  - The middle band has fallen from 2683.93 (10-07), a steady downtrend in the 20-day mean.
  - The ~301-point band width reflects elevated but not extreme volatility.
  - Overshoots of the lower band appeared around 10-29/10-30, but I don't have the daily band series to confirm exact breaches.
- **ATR, 79.64:**
  - It has eased from 94.94 (10-16) as the last two sessions were quiet.
  - One ATR is about 3.5% of the current price.
  - Actual daily ranges were larger on 10-29 and 10-30, so the ATR can understate the risk of a sudden expansion.
- **VWMA, 2343.35:**
  - It sits **above price** and also below the Bollinger middle (2369.55). That is consistent with more volume trading at lower prices recently (the 10-29 and 10-30 sessions were 18.8B and 20.0B).
  - Volume weighting therefore agrees with the bearish read rather than suggesting hidden accumulation.
  - The weekend bounce volumes (4.36B, 4.55B) are low compared with the weekday selling. The rebound lacks volume confirmation, though weekend volumes tend to run lower.

## 7. Key levels (reference, not validated bounces)

- **Overhead:**
  - 2307.89 (10 EMA)
  - 2343.35 (VWMA)
  - 2357.62 (10-28 close)
  - 2369.55 (Bollinger middle)
  - 2515.28 (50 SMA) and 2519.93 (upper band)
- **Below:**
  - 2219.18 (lower band)
  - 2173.30 (10-30 intraday low)
  - 2157.63 (200 SMA)
  - If the 200 SMA fails, the prior pre-breakout consolidation (closes of roughly 1,840–1,920 through 2026-08-18) is the next reference area. That is a structural observation, not a confirmed support level.

## 8. Scenarios

- **Bearish continuation:** The lower-highs sequence, falling 10 EMA/50 SMA, negative MACD and volume-weighted selling all lean this way.
  - Trigger: a daily close below the 10-30 low (2173.30) and then the 200 SMA (~2158).
  - Confirmation would be MACD making new lows and RSI closing below 30.
- **Relief bounce or base:** RSI near 30, a compressed range and price still above the 200 SMA allow a reflex bounce.
  - The first test is the 10 EMA (2307.89), then VWMA/Bollinger middle (2343–2370).
  - A durable change needs a close above ~2370 with the MACD histogram turning up and volume expanding on up days.
  - Failure near those moving averages would continue the lower-high pattern.
- **My read:** The bias is bearish-to-neutral on the medium term, with the long-term trend still intact above the 200 SMA. The bounce on thin volume is unconfirmed.

## 9. Risk management

- **Stops:** Use ATR-scaled stops. 1.5× ATR is about 119 points and 2× ATR is about 159 points. For example, a stop under the 10-30 low (2173.30) is only ~90 points below the current close, which is about 1.1× ATR, so it is tight for this volatility.
- **Position size:** Size positions on the stop distance, not on conviction. The ATR is elevated relative to the quiet last two sessions.
- **Event risk:** The 08-19 gap and the 10-07/10-08 and 10-29 drops show this asset can move well beyond one ATR in a day.

## 10. Summary table

| 10 EMA | 2307.89 | Price 44.83 below; short-term bearish |

# ETH-USD Fundamental Report (as of 2026-11-01)

## 1. Scope and data availability

ETH-USD (Ethereum USD, exchange: CCC) is a crypto asset, not a company. It has no income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, or insider filings in the traditional sense. I called all five tools, and this is what came back:

| Tool | Result |
|---|---|
| get_fundamentals | Returned limited market-level data (below) |
| get_balance_sheet (quarterly) | NO_DATA_AVAILABLE |
| get_cashflow (quarterly) | NO_DATA_AVAILABLE |
| get_income_statement (quarterly) | NO_DATA_AVAILABLE |
| get_insider_transactions | No insider transactions reported |

I have not estimated or filled in any of the missing statements. The absence of data is expected for this kind of instrument and does not signal a problem with the asset.

## 2. Data returned

- **Market capitalization:** about $276.5 billion USD
- **52-week high:** $3,914.88
- **52-week low:** $1,506.51
- **50-day average price:** $2,520.54
- **200-day average price:** $2,158.11

The tool did not return a current spot price, so I did not compute the exact distance from the high or low.

## 3. What the numbers suggest

- **Range:** The 52-week high is about 2.6 times the low (3,914.88 / 1,506.51 ≈ 2.60). That is a very wide range and shows high volatility over the year.
- **Trend:** The 50-day average ($2,520.54) is about 16.8% above the 200-day average ($2,158.11). This is a bullish moving-average configuration, meaning medium-term prices have been running above the longer-term trend. Technically this is often read as an uptrend or recovery, but it is a lagging signal.
- **Position within the range:** The 50-day average sits roughly 42% of the way from the 52-week low to the high ((2,520.54 − 1,506.51) / (3,914.88 − 1,506.51) ≈ 0.42). The asset has therefore not recovered to its peak. Whether spot is above or below that level is unknown from this data.
- **Implied supply:** Market cap divided by the 50-day average price gives roughly 110 million ETH, which is below the roughly 120 million figure I would expect. That comparison mixes a spot-based market cap with an averaged price, so it should not be used as a supply estimate. I would not rely on it.

## 4. What I could not assess

The tools do not cover the data that normally drives a view on ETH:

- On-chain activity: active addresses, transaction counts, and fees
- Network revenue and fee burn (EIP-1559), and net issuance or inflation
- Staking: total staked ETH, staking yield, and validator count
- Exchange reserves and ETF/institutional flows
- Layer-2 activity and total value locked in DeFi
- Protocol upgrade roadmap and regulatory developments
- Large-holder (whale) and treasury-company wallet movements, which are the closest analogue to insider activity
